findings.title: Prompt/description injection heuristics
remediation: Remove or quarantine manipulative instructions; add client-side guards.

findings.title: Tool description stability (anti rug-pull)
remediation: Version tool descriptions and notify clients; require re-approval.

findings.title: Resource URI validation & path traversal prevention
remediation: Add resource roots allowlists; disable proxying unless necessary; sanitize paths.

findings.title: Per-resource access control
remediation: Bind resource access to explicit scopes/claims.

findings.title: Sensitive resource exposure
remediation: Do not expose internal credentials as resources; gate behind RBAC and remove from listing.
Store secrets in a vault; never return them via MCP.
references: Challenge 1: Basic Prompt Injection risk via sensitive resources

findings.title: Input validation & injection fuzzing
findings.details: [{"tool": "get_api_endpoint_schema", "payload": "../../../../etc/passwd", "resp": {"result": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Error executing hive tool: Error: Endpoint ../../../../etc/passwd not found"}]}, "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1}}, {"tool": "call_api_endpoint", "payload": "../../../../etc/passwd", "resp": {"result": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Error executing hive tool: Tool '../../../../etc/passwd' not found"}]}, "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1}}]
remediation: Apply allowlists, strict parsers, sandboxing; disable raw shells and arbitrary fetch.

findings.title: Token indirection (no upstream token pass-through)
remediation: Adopt token indirection: never pass through upstream tokens to clients.
references: MCP Auth best practices: avoid confused deputy

findings.title: Indirect prompt injection via external resources
remediation: Sanitize/strip untrusted content, apply allowlists and guardrails in LLM prompts
Require HIL or sandbox for external content processing
